en: Down the nine stone steps at dawn
id: Kala fajar kuturuni sembilan anak tangga batu
zh: 黎明时我走下九级石阶
sung: Down the nine stone steps at dawn

en: I fill my jars where the river bends
id: Kuisi tempayanku di tikungan sungai
zh: 在河湾处把陶罐盛满
sung: I fill my jars where the river bends

en: I copy hymns till the sun is gone
id: Kusalin kidung pujian hingga mentari tenggelam
zh: 我抄写颂歌，直到太阳西沉
sung: I copy hymns till the sun is gone

en: I light the lamps when the long day ends
id: Kunyalakan pelita saat hari panjang usai
zh: 漫长的一天结束时，我点亮灯火
sung: I light the lamps when the long day ends

en: I paint the heroes on the temple wall
id: Kulukis para pahlawan di dinding kuil
zh: 我在神庙墙上描绘英雄
sung: I paint the heroes on the temple wall

en: I write their names in gold, but never mine
id: Kutulis nama mereka dengan emas, tapi tak pernah namaku
zh: 用金箔写下他们的名字，却从没有我的
sung: I write their names in gold, but never mine

en: But the boats go sailing to the sea
id: Namun perahu-perahu berlayar menuju laut
zh: 可是船只一艘艘驶向大海
sung: But the boats go sailing to the sea

en: And every sail is calling me
id: Dan setiap layar memanggilku
zh: 每一张帆都在呼唤我
sung: And every sail is calling me

en: Let me rise, let me rise like the sun on the river
id: Biar aku terbit, terbit bagai mentari di atas sungai
zh: 让我升起，像河上的太阳一样升起
sung: Let me rise, let me rise like the sun on the river

en: Let me sail past the reeds and away
id: Biar aku berlayar melewati rumpun buluh, jauh pergi
zh: 让我驶过芦苇，远远离去
sung: Let me sail past the reeds and away

en: I have written in gold every hero's story
id: Telah kutulis dengan emas kisah setiap pahlawan
zh: 我已用金箔写下每位英雄的故事
sung: I have written in gold every hero's story

en: Now it's my turn to take the stage
id: Kini giliranku naik ke panggung
zh: 现在轮到我登上舞台
sung: Now it's my turn to take the stage

en: Mother says the walls will keep me safe
id: Ibu berkata tembok ini akan menjagaku
zh: 母亲说高墙会护我周全
sung: Mother says the walls will keep me safe

en: That a girl should keep the flame instead
id: Bahwa seorang gadis cukup menjaga api saja
zh: 女孩只该守着这盏灯火
sung: That a girl should keep the flame instead

en: But a flame was made to light the dark
id: Tapi api tercipta untuk menerangi gelap
zh: 可火焰生来就要照亮黑暗
sung: But a flame was made to light the dark

en: And I was made to find my way
id: Dan aku tercipta untuk menemukan jalanku
zh: 而我生来就要找到自己的路
sung: And I was made to find my way

zh: 可是船只一艘艘驶向大海

zh: 现在轮到我登上舞台
sung: Now it's my turn to take the stage

en: When the river rises in the night
id: Saat sungai meluap di tengah malam
zh: 当河水在夜里上涨
sung: When the river rises in the night

en: And the sky bends low with all her stars
id: Dan langit merunduk dengan seluruh bintangnya
zh: 天空带着满天繁星低垂
sung: And the sky bends low with all her stars

en: I will take the oar and I will go
id: Akan kugenggam dayung dan aku akan pergi
zh: 我会握起船桨，启程远行
sung: I will take the oar and I will go

en: And the morning will find me far
id: Dan pagi akan menemukanku di kejauhan
zh: 清晨将在远方找到我
sung: And the morning will find me far

zh: 让我升起，像河上的太阳一样升起

en: Let the whole wide world hear my name
id: Biar seluruh dunia mendengar namaku
zh: 让这广阔世界听见我的名字
sung: Let the whole wide world hear my name

en: I am ready, let me rise
id: Aku siap, biar aku terbit
zh: 我已准备好，让我升起
sung: I am ready, let me rise

en: Like the sun on the river, let me rise
id: Bagai mentari di atas sungai, biar aku terbit
zh: 像河上的太阳，让我升起
sung: Like the sun on the river, let me rise
